semantic.justification: Task6764KT reads actual SFNT/TTC table containers at the browser byte boundary and preserves the defined PhysicalFontFace OS/2 coverage algorithm: original offsets42/78,word-to-bit ordering,optional codepage set and last-successful-word reuse after short reads. WRITER074 records version-zero/partial-read behavior and the uninitialized-first-word boundary, where the browser exposes unknown data rather than emulating C++ uninitialized memory. The core file contains only the extracted capability algorithm; no fake PhysicalFontFace class or service is introduced. Native physical-face ownership,HarfBuzz cmap/collection face selection and dropdown rendering remain unfinished. Collection capability reads require an explicit resolved face index. Actual repository fonts and synthetic binary-boundary cases are checked; advertised coverage is not glyph support. Task6764KT transfers only the consumed HarfBuzz14.2.1 sanitized table selection,unicode collection and glyph-population algorithms. Source archive SHA-256 is pinned by LibreOffice download.lst. Native JavaScript Set,DataView and garbage collection own storage; browser Canvas continues shaping/rasterization. No HarfBuzz memory manager,library install or full text shaper is ported. Source encoding binary search,preference,format0/4/6/10/12/13/14 handling,remaining-cmap format4 bounds,ordered segment mutation,uint32 arithmetic and default beyond-64K loca population are retained. WRITER081/082 document suspected upstream collection discrepancies. Real physical style/weight/encoding selection,collection identity resolution and dropdown paint integration remain unfinished; no full font/UI parity is claimed.
